app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Secondary Primary Amount: Supplies the shared primary-training cutoff as 1/X, or an explicit probability; zero includes every known rate.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Secondary Primary Inclusive: Counts sources exactly at the required-training cutoff in tasks, Activity Info and equipment comparisons. On by default.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Wield Crafted Items: Controls whether crafted items can be used for training and equipment comparisons.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Smithing by Smelting: Allows Smithing processing without an accessible anvil.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Puro-Puro: Blocks automatic access to the declared Puro-Puro area.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Skill Tasks: Shows or hides active skill tasks.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Quest Tasks: Shows or hides active quest tasks.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Quest Tasks Complete: Shows whole-quest completion tasks instead of individual quest steps.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Achievement: Shows or hides active achievement tasks. Hidden achievements can still unlock rewards and count towards other requirements.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Diary Tasks: Enable area achievements and their rewards. Other achievement families keep their own rules; Achievement controls active display.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Diary Tasks Complete: Show whole-tier achievement completion duties instead of individual duties.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Diary Tasks Any: Allow individual area achievement duties before earlier tiers are completable. Their own requirements still apply, and a completable tier still groups its duties.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Highest Level: Uses the highest available processing method for each consumable ingredient and skill when deciding which products you can make. Some original links between highest-level tasks are still unsupported.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Hide Partial Products: Hides listed skill tasks for unfinished products.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Cleaning Herbs: Hides skill tasks for cleaning herbs and making unfinished potions.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Best in Slot Melee Style Tasks: Splits melee weapon comparisons into Stab, Slash and Crush.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Best in Slot 1H and 2H: Keeps both one-handed and two-handed weapon loadout winners.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Best in Slot Shield: Keeps a shield loadout winner alongside off-hand weapon winners.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Show Best in Slot Defensive Tasks: Ranks ordinary armour by armour then life points and compatible hand loadouts by total armour plus life points; ties and style flags remain explicit.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Consumable Primary BiS: Requires consumable equipment to have a source that also qualifies for required training tasks.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Non-permanent BiS: Includes temporary equipment and equipment that expires or degrades to dust in equipment comparisons by default. Disable to compare permanent replacements before choosing Best in Slot goals, loadouts, alternatives and upgrade paths. Repairable or rechargeable gear and ammunition remain included.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Kill X: Adds kill-count goals for reachable monsters, following your backlog, Skiller, boss and Slayer level rules, including known boosts. You still need to tick off completion.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Kill X Boss: Includes listed bosses in Kill X goals when you can reach them and meet their requirements.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Kill X Amount: Sets the displayed positive safe-integer kill count while preserving stable X goal IDs.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Every Drop: Adds item collection goals from available monsters and other listed sources. You can choose another source for the same item; related tasks share completion where recorded. Drop-rate and access rules still apply.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Every Drop Implings: Includes available listed impling catches in Every Drop goals.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Every Drop Thieving: Includes available listed Thieving methods in Every Drop goals, except drops marked hidden in the game data.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.Every Drop BGH: Includes available listed Big Game Hunter methods in Every Drop goals.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.All Droptables: Adds goals for each item and quantity in available monster and task drop tables. Quantity ranges are preserved. Missing tables or tables that refer back to themselves are excluded.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.All Droptables Nest: Adds quantity goals for obtainable nests with a listed loot table and nest-loot task. The original game data has no matching nest-loot task.
app/data/settings.mjs#explicitRuleBehavi.All Shops: Adds buy-each-item goals for items sold by specific reachable shops or listed shop tasks. Ticking a collection goal does not record that you still own the item.

app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.Boosting: Uses obtainable fixed-level and percentage boosts, banned sources and the Crystal saw. XP-based boost formulas are unsupported. Availability uses reachable levels; displayed requirements adjust for the target level, so they can differ.
app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.BIS Skilling: Shows listed best skilling equipment goals, comparing recorded equipment sets and priorities alongside separate convenience upgrades. Hidden goals can still count towards other requirements; some behavior differs from the original picker.
app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.Skiller: Excludes monster drops and tasks marked unsuitable for skillers. The full original Skiller restrictions are not yet supported.
app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.BIS Skilling Relics: Controls listed relic tasks and shows their recorded requirements. Some interactions with BIS Skilling are still incomplete. The picker does not choose the best relic combination or relic-power allocation.
app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.PvM Relics: Shows listed combat relic requirements when present. The original game data has no matching combat relic tasks. The picker does not choose the best relic combination or relic-power allocation.
app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.Show Best in Slot Weight Tasks: Ranks verified worn weight by ordinary slot; missing or ambiguous weights remain outside the comparison. Coupled weight loadouts are not ranked.
app/data/settings.mjs#partialRuleBehavio.F2P: Legacy flag is overridden by the shared content.f2p rule; this task-rule key cannot independently change F2P.

app/data/settings.mjs#missingGeneratedBe.Wield Crafted Items Override: Saved for compatibility with the original picker; its effect is not yet supported here.
app/data/settings.mjs#missingGeneratedBe.Secondary MTA: Saved for compatibility with the original picker; its Mage Training Arena rule for secondary rune sources is not yet supported here.

app/data/settings.mjs#retainedRuleBehavi.Cleaning herbs: This older spelling is saved for compatibility and has no effect. Use Cleaning Herbs to show or hide cleaning tasks and Cleaning Herbs Primary to control required training.

app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.label: Death-chunk threshold (active person-hours)
app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.description: Flag a roll candidate when its slowest new task would take longer than this many hours of play. Skulls are advice only; they never block a roll.

app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.label: Default effective seconds per kill (placeholder)
app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.description: A starting guess until you time yourself. Count everything: fighting, respawns, travel and banking.

app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.label: Per-monster effective seconds per kill
app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.description: Set your own pace for specific monsters. Use the name exactly as it appears in a task’s sources.

app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.label: Show death-chunk skulls
app/core/death-settings.mjs#deathSetting.description: Mark death chunks among your roll candidates on the map. Chunk details still show the estimate.

app/core/banking-settings.mjs#bankingSet.label: Finish each backpack
app/core/banking-settings.mjs#bankingSet.description: Drop gathered resources or bank them to keep them.

app/core/banking-settings.mjs#bankingSet.label: Ore box owned
app/core/banking-settings.mjs#bankingSet.description: Choose the ore box you carry. None assumes no ore box.

app/core/banking-settings.mjs#bankingSet.label: Wood box owned
app/core/banking-settings.mjs#bankingSet.description: Choose the wood box you carry. None assumes no wood box. Multiple wood boxes share storage.

app/core/mining-settings.mjs#miningSetti.label: Mining pickaxe
app/core/mining-settings.mjs#miningSetti.description: Use the best F2P pickaxe for your Mining level, or choose the pickaxe you use.

app/core/mining-settings.mjs#miningSetti.label: Mining attention
app/core/mining-settings.mjs#miningSetti.description: Choose how often you click while mining. Rates are at the rock, with no banking.

app/core/woodcutting-settings.mjs#woodcu.label: Woodcutting hatchet
app/core/woodcutting-settings.mjs#woodcu.description: Use the best F2P hatchet for your Woodcutting level, or choose the hatchet you use.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Cache skill-guide tasks
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Add reviewed skill-guide actions from the game files when their locations and requirements are verified. Level-only milestones need the separate optional milestone rule.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Optional skill-guide milestones
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: With Cache skill-guide tasks enabled, also make informational thresholds such as standard no-burn cooking levels optional goals. These thresholds produce no item and remain in the guide catalogue when disabled.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Reviewed skill-guide and combat corrections
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Apply reviewed task membership and numeric level corrections supported by cache and Wiki evidence.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Connected partner capabilities
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Use training and resources in your partner’s territory when you can get there and back. Required tasks and places you roll from still come from your own reachable map.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Automatic teleport and transport availability
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Check your travel options using synced levels and quests, obtainable supplies and lodestones. Without synced levels, the highest level you can train to is an estimate. Destinations stay locked until you unlock them.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Admit verified transport routes
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Use verified boats, teleports and other transport to reach areas and add roll candidates. You must meet the personal levels, quests, item and fare requirements. Partner resources require a route back. Travel does not change chunk ownership or walking connections.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Chunks added to the roll pool by hand can be rolled
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Include your hand-added chunks when rolling. Other roll rules still apply.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Adjacent chunks
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Include neighbouring chunks you can enter from your own reachable unlocked terrain. Frontier mode includes neighbours on the grid even without a verified walking connection.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Neighbor candidate mode
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Accessible includes neighbours with a recorded walking connection from reachable unlocked terrain and is the default. Manual uses only chunks added to the roll pool by hand. Frontier includes grid neighbours even without a walking connection. Free-to-play rules still apply.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Empty the hand-added roll pool after each roll
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: After you unlock a rolled chunk, remove the remaining hand-added chunks from the roll pool. Cancelling a roll keeps them.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Walkable generated candidates
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: In Frontier mode, only add neighbouring chunks marked walkable. Accessible mode checks recorded walking connections instead. Chunks added to the roll pool by hand bypass this filter.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Usable teleport destinations
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: An available teleport adds a destination to the roll pool without unlocking it.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Teleport availability scope
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Personal uses only the rolling member’s usable teleports; group is an optional house rule.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Allow consumable teleports
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Include usable teleports that consume runes, tablets or charges.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Free-to-play generated candidates
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Only add free-to-play terrain to the roll pool. Chunks with both free and members areas need a free entry area. Chunks added to the roll pool by hand bypass this filter.

app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.label: Task completion scope
app/core/rules.mjs#rulePresentation.description: Any member, every member, or the current member may satisfy a task; personal records remain separate.

Achievement.description: Show Achievement Tasks from enabled achievement groups. Hidden achievements can still unlock rewards and count towards other requirements.

Show Diary Tasks.description: Enable Area Tasks achievements. Other achievement families keep their own rules; Achievement controls their active display.

Show Diary Tasks Any.description: Allow individual Area Tasks achievements without a completable prerequisite tier. Their own location, item, skill, membership and family requirements still apply.

Non-permanent BiS.description: Include equipment that degrades to dust, runs out or is temporary in Best in Slot tasks. Repairable or rechargeable equipment and ammunition remain included when disabled.

House storage tasks.description: Add optional house storage and display goals when you can obtain every required item, complete the housing quest and build the furniture. Deposit furniture requires membership; bookcases retrieve books automatically and have no fill tasks.

Rare Drop.description: When enabled, include all drop rates. When disabled, apply Rare Drop Amount and Rare Drop Inclusive; unknown rates remain admitted.

Rare Drop Amount.description: Use drops more common than 1/X. X is a positive denominator, including decimals (0.5 means 1/0.5); 0 includes everything. An explicit a/b is a probability. A drop exactly at the cutoff counts only when Rare Drop Inclusive is checked.

Rare Drop Inclusive.description: Include drops with a rate exactly equal to Rare Drop Amount. Off by default, matching the original picker.

Secondary Primary.description: Allow methods listed as Secondary Primary to create required training tasks when you can obtain the supplies and meet the method’s requirements.

Secondary Primary Amount.description: A known source rate more common than 1/X can count as primary training. X is a positive denominator, including decimals (0.5 means 1/0.5); 0 includes every known rate. An explicit a/b is a probability. A rate exactly at the cutoff qualifies when Secondary Primary Inclusive is checked (on by default).

Secondary Primary Inclusive.description: Count a known source exactly at the primary-training cutoff as primary. On by default for the duo’s nothing-below-the-cutoff house rule; unknown rates never qualify.

Boss.description: Boss drops from the picker’s boss list count as item sources; turning it off removes those drops as sources but does not stop killing or training on bosses, Kill X Boss goals or boss collection-log tasks.
